WEATHERPARSE WINDY UPDATER GUIDE
================================

Warning:
    Windy has changed its station API: the old upload address (stations.windy.com/pws/update) now redirects.
    The WeatherParse Windy uploader is being updated to Windy's current API; check the WeatherParse changelog
    (CHANGELOG.txt) before relying on Windy uploads. Windy's registration pages below may also have moved; follow
    Windy's current instructions if they differ.

Registration
============

1. Go to https://community.windy.com/register and fill out the form.
1. Agree to the data collection policy.
1. Visit https://stations.windy.com/stations and add a new station.
1. When your station is added, click "Show Key" to get your API Key.

Configuration
=============

1. Change enabled to true.
1. Add your Windy ID, Station ID, and API Key.
    1. ID is the first ID NOT the Station ID.
    1. If you have multiple Windy stations, enter your station ID. Default is 0.

Webcam
======

1. Visit https://www.windy.com/webcams/add and add a new camera.
    1. Page URL = http(s)://<yourip/domain>/camera
    1. Image URL = http(s)://<yourip/domain>/img/cam/latest.jpg
